_note: Literal numbers that must never appear in the published analog chapter,
checked by check_fragments.py over every fragment the chapter reaches.
This is the last line of defence, and the only one that does not depend on
a config staying correct: maestro2tex's own `superseded` key stops a
fragment being regenerated, but deleting that key removes the guard along
with it.  A wrong NUMBER cannot come back through any route -- regenerated,
hand-copied, or restored from an old file -- without failing this check.
Add an entry when a published number is found to be wrong and the fragment
that carried it is superseded.  Keep the pattern narrow enough that the
CORRECTED number cannot match it: the guards below key on the full row of
corner values, not on a single figure.
